title: Amazon Web Services IAM user secret access key: benign placeholder controls
summary: 4 inputs holding documentation placeholders and example values for the credential.
rationale: Documentation is written to be copied. A placeholder was never issued, so reporting it is noise, and a scanner that stays silent on it must not also stay silent on a real value in the same position.

expectation.rationale: Placeholder, reference, template, mask, documentation or ordinary text. Expected silence is project policy.
